name: Muha Meds | 2g Disposable (3rd Gen) | Bubble Gum Burst
description: Bubblegum Burst smacks of fruity sweetness that takes you straight back to the corner store. It’s a bright, buzzy sativa that lights up your senses and keeps the vibes moving. Perfect for when you want that playful, wide-awake energy.
